h1: Custom Pocketed Tank Tops for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Pocketed Tank Tops | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom pocketed tank tops in bulk for your team or event. Perfect for promotions, uniforms, and giveaways at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom pocketed tank tops offer extra utility that standard tank tops cannot match. The added chest pocket provides a convenient spot for pens, small tools, or badges, making them ideal for outdoor events, construction crews, or casual staff uniforms. Choose from cotton or performance blends, and add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that stands up to repeated wear.
heroAltText: A group of custom pocketed tank tops in various colors with printed logos, stacked for bulk order display.
